Clang 23.1.1, explicit x86 MSVC-ABI compiler profile
==================================================

Official LLVM-MinGW 20260908 portable Windows x64 release:
https://github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw/releases/tag/20260908
https://github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw/releases/download/20260908/llvm-mingw-20260908-ucrt-x86_64.zip

Upstream archive: 190677197 bytes
SHA256: 1bcf74d06b724aeecaa6412ca85f5b26fb1da770e7cdcefa9263c9c5c3ad34b6
The digest agrees with the release asset's GitHub API digest.
Compiler reports Clang 23.1.1, LLVM revision
6dfe1677ab8dffbc6ec13d53a1e0215d75147689.

compiler.zip is a deterministic ZIP of five unmodified binaries from that
release's bin/ directory. clang-23.exe is renamed clang-cl.exe so the same
unmodified driver selects its MSVC-compatible command-line mode. The other
members are libLLVM-23.dll, libclang-cpp.dll, libc++.dll and libunwind.dll.
DLL imports were inspected to establish this complete non-system dependency
closure. Windows system/UCRT DLLs are not redistributed. No installer ran.
No MinGW headers, import libraries, target runtime or executable wrapper is used.
The upstream root LICENSE.TXT is reproduced verbatim as license.txt.

Derived compiler.zip: 49535500 bytes
SHA256: 809f74c74c28983bcd23360f17cf0ed877946065a6e58430214bb035ccd2cd2d
Each member hash is independently pinned in tools/compiler_profiles.py.
ZIP members have the fixed timestamp 1980-01-01 and DEFLATE level 9.

Purpose: the plain C++ security-cookie comparison at retail 0x00629BAB
needs CMP/JNE/RET/JMP, including preservation of incoming EAX and EDX.
MSVC 7.1 variants give CMP/JE/JMP/RET. This Clang backend, with its ordinary
-branch-folder-reorder-blocks=false optimization option, emits the complete
14-byte retail body with the real cookie and report_failure relocations.
This is an alternate reconstruction toolchain, not a retail compiler claim.

Selection is explicit: // compiler: clang23-x86. The build always passes
--target=i686-pc-windows-msvc. Default MSVC selection, INCLUDE and LIB are
unchanged. Archive and expanded executable hashes enter receipts; the hook's
ledger guard byte-binds the profile implementation and package to the state
being verified. Altered packages or an altered existing cache refuse. No
compiler patch, assembly template, object rewriting or verification mask is used.

Legacy MSVC region tuning flags G5/G6/G7 are translated explicitly to
Clang -mtune=pentium/pentiumpro/pentium4. Other flags pass through unchanged;
the default MSVC profile receives exactly its original arguments. This is
compiler option adaptation, not a byte-verification exception.

The upstream host MinGW-w64 notices are reproduced verbatim under notices/
for any runtime portions included in these original compiler binaries.
